Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 13, 2026) - Caprock Mining Corp. (CSE: CAPR) ("Caprock", or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has entered into an investor relations agreement with Epstein Research ("ER") (the "Agreement") to increase investor engagement and awareness. ER's engagement is for an initial term of three months, commencing November 15, 2026 and ending February 15, 2027, and may be renewed or cancelled in accordance with the terms of the Agreement.

Under the terms of the Agreement, ER will provide promotional services, including social media and online advertising regarding the Company posted on the ER homepage (www.epsteinresearch.com), CEO.ca, Substack and LinkedIn; monthly written articles on the Company and/or CEO interviews written exclusively by Peter Epstein; and online commentary on the Company on websites including CEO.ca, Stockhouse, TalkMarkets, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Yahoo Finance, Facebook, YouTube and StockTwits.

ER is a research and analysis firm wholly owned and operated by Peter Epstein, specializing in investor engagement and market awareness for public companies. As consideration for the services, the Company will pay ER an aggregate cash fee of US$6,000. The Company will not issue any securities, including options to purchase securities, to ER as compensation. ER and its principal are arm's length to the Company and do not have any interest, direct or indirect, in the Company or its securities, nor do they have any right to acquire such an interest. ER is located at 31 Goldfinch Drive, Upper Saddle River, NJ 07458, and can be contacted at epstein.peter4@gmail.com or (845) 304-7386.

About Caprock Mining Corp.

Caprock Mining Corp. is a Canadian mineral exploration company focused on exploring precious metals in Quebec and Ontario.

The Company has an option to earn a 100% interest in the Destiny gold property (the "Property") that comprises 127 mineral claims and encompasses an area of 5,013 hectares located less than two hours' drive from Val d'Or, Quebec. Destiny lies along a major deformation corridor in the Abitibi greenstone belt that includes the prolific Cadillac-Larder Lake, Destor-Porcupine and Casa Berardi fault zones, which host numerous producing and development-stage gold deposits. The Property overlies a 6.0 km long segment of the poorly explored Despinassy shear zone, which is a splay off the regional Chicobi Fault. Destiny hosts a significant, open pit-constrained, NI 43-101-compliant Mineral Resource Estimate published in March 2025.

Advanced Micro Devices' (AMD) stock looks poised to revisit its all-time highs. The market has already bought into its growth story. Now, the next opportunity may lie in how much of that growth turns into profits. After a triple-digit gain in 2026, the stock has pulled back from its October record highs, but the fundamentals help explain much of that rally.

In its third-quarter earnings report, released on November 3, the Santa Clara, California-based chipmaker reported that its Data Center revenue nearly doubled, along with a great improvement in margins.

The most interesting part may still be ahead. With much greater visibility into 2027, I believe the market still underestimates the company's earnings growth potential. That's why I remain bullish, even with an already demanding valuation.

AMD's Data Center Growth Explains Much of the Rally

First, I think it's important to put AMD's remarkable triple-digit rally this year into context. I see two key metrics that have marked a turning point in the company's investment thesis: Data Center revenue growth and forward revenue growth.

Let's start by breaking down the first metric. Basically, the market has gone from viewing AMD as a central processing unit (CPU) manufacturer trying to gain ground in artificial intelligence (AI) graphics processing units (GPUs) to treating it as a potential second major AI infrastructure platform, behind Nvidia (NVDA).

The acceleration driven by AI demand really began to show up in AMD's results in 2026, something that wasn't nearly as pronounced in 2025. To be more specific, in the third quarter of 2025, AMD generated $4.34 billion in Data Center revenue, up 22% year-over-year. A year later, that revenue reached $8.55 billion, a 97% jump, driven by both EPYC processors, benefiting particularly from the growth of AI agents, and Instinct MI450 GPUs. As a result, Data Center now accounts for 64% of the company's total revenue, compared to less than 50% in the same period last year.

As if that weren't enough, this growth came with a considerable improvement in the segment's profitability. Data Center's operating margin rose from 25% to 34%. So, we're talking about a company whose core business has nearly doubled in size while its margins have expanded by an impressive 9 percentage points.

title: Wall Street Is Writing Off Nvidia Stock. Here's Why That's a Mistake.
detail:
Wall Street Is Writing Off Nvidia Stock. Here's Why That's a Mistake.
Ryan Vanzo, The Motley Fool
Fri, November 13, 2026 at 11:37 AM PST 5 min read
NVDA
GOOGN
META
Explore stocks on Coinbase
Trading disclosure

Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) shares currently face a litany of headwinds.

The first challenge has been a correction across AI stocks. Not every AI stock has been targeted. But many industry suppliers have seen their share prices slashed by 10%, 20%, or even 30% in recent weeks. Both Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG)(NASDAQ: GOOGL) and Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META), for example, have lost roughly 15% of their value over the past month.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

The second challenge concerns CEO Jensen Huang's affair with tech executive and investor Alice Huang, who faces allegations that she's a Chinese spy. Nvidia issued a press release apologizing for its leaders' actions, but uncertainty remains regarding potential regulatory actions. A second alleged affair -- this one with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia's vice president of healthcare -- was later uncovered by The New York Times. Nvidia's board was considering ousting Huang from his role, but on Thursday morning, he resigned. For now, Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will step into the CEO role on an interim basis.

As difficult as those issues are for the chipmaker, the third challenge could have a lasting impact.

Major Nvidia customer Anthropic this week updated its pre-IPO filing with the claim that it had been able to adapt its Claude Mythos large language model to run on AMD's competing hardware in just three days. That success would drastically reduce Anthropic's reliance on Nvidia chips, as it would dramatically reduce the moat created by Nvidia's CUDA software platform.

As industry news site Wccf tech explains:

"Anthropic's IPO roadshow material has one very interesting nugget: a slide that shows it took its Claude Mythos Preview model just around three days to figure out how to run another model on AMD's MI355X GPUs vs. the 6-12 months that it typically takes to prepare a new compute platform for inference-related operations. Basically, Anthropic is now treating GPUs as fungible units of compute, with a significantly reduced barrier to switch from one platform to another. This is predictably leading some to declare that Nvidia's CUDA moat might well be dead for all practical intents and purposes."

In response, Wall Street has cooled further on Nvidia stock. To be clear, most analysts covering the company still maintain a "buy" rating on its shares. But in recent days, three of them have lowered their 12-month price targets. Notably, analysts at Robert W. Baird have lowered their price target from $500 per share to just $200. Additional downgrades or price target reductions may be in the cards as additional headwinds are digested.

title: Should You Wait Before Buying Reddit Stock?
detail:
Should You Wait Before Buying Reddit Stock?

Reddit (RDDT) stock has lost 52.2% over the past twelve months, while the S&P 500 returned 12.2%. The shares now sit 61.6% below their January 2026 high, and on the October 29 call management warned that the number of people using Reddit each day could fall in the final quarter of 2026. Is $99.55 a low enough price to buy before Reddit shows whether it actually loses users?

Reddit Costs Less Than The S&P 500 On Earnings

Reddit trades at 19.3 times its earnings over the last twelve months, against 21.9 for the S&P 500. On sales the multiple has fallen sharply: buyers paid 22.7 times sales at the end of September 2025, and they pay 6.2 times today, still above the 3.2 for the S&P 500. That cheaper price comes with better margins, not worse ones. Reddit's operating margin over the twelve months to September 2026 was 29.4%, its highest at any of the 21 quarter ends since September 2021.

Profit is taxed lightly for now, with a tax rate of about 2% in the third quarter. That low rate lifts reported profit, so the earnings multiple would be higher at a normal tax rate. On cash, Reddit trades at 15.9 times operating cash flow, about level with 15.4 for the S&P 500, so on both measures Reddit is priced close to the market or below it.

The business kept growing, too: revenue rose 53% in the third quarter. Management's caution on the call was about users. Management said search referral traffic fell meaningfully in the quarter, with the decline speeding up late, and that Google is not sending people to Reddit the way it used to.

What Must Reddit Deliver In Its Fourth Quarter?

Reddit has guided fourth-quarter revenue of $1.0 billion to $1.03 billion, or 38% to 42% above a year earlier. The consensus for that quarter is $1.05 billion. With that figure sitting about $20 million above the top of the guide, the price appears to assume another beat. That sets a high bar for a company whose growth slowed in each quarter of 2026, dropping from 69.1% in the first to 53.0% in the third.

Management also warned about users. Search traffic dropped by more than 1 million referrals a week on average in October. If that pace continues, management said, daily users could fall in the fourth quarter by a low double-digit percentage from 130 million. Reddit will also begin testing a logged-in-only version in select markets outside the U.S. in the same quarter, which management said will likely trade reach for engagement.
